headline: Closed-door discussion of Superintendent Iris White's 2025-2026 evaluation and 2026-2027 goals; no votes taken.
summary: Commissioners met in executive session to discuss the superintendent's evaluation and her goals for the coming year. After returning to public session, they took no votes on those items.
